# CRL OCSP Monitor - Email Server Settings

<br>

In order to send emails the tool requires the smtp email server details. To configure these click the ![img](data:image/png;base64,) button. The following dialog will be displayed

![img](data:image/png;base64,)

Enter the email server address, port and from address. If the mail server requires SSL check the Use SSL option

If the server requires authentication, check the **Server requires credentials** option and enter the username and password

The subject and text for failure and success emails can also be specified here

The %URL% and %TESTCASE% tags can be added anywhere in the subject or text. These tags will be substituted for the actual OCSP URL and test case name in the emails sent

In addition to the Email Text configured further information detailing the test case and exact error will also be included in the emails
